targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensor_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "temperature")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "humidity")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "distance_cm")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device_id"])
